```sql
SELECT 
    p.ID,
    COUNT(*) as abnormal_lab_count
FROM main."Patient" p
JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."Date") = 1997
    AND l.GOT >= 60
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
```
